Rashi on Chullin 55b:10:1.hebrew: ארישא קאי - אף בידי כל הבריות, כבידי שמים:
Rashi on Chullin 55b:10:1.english: Is referring to the first clause - [Meaning that] "even by the hands of all creatures" is like "by the hand of Heaven."

Rashi on Chullin 55b:11:1.english: Come and hear - [This proves] that he refers to the latter clause.

Rashi on Chullin 55b:12:2.hebrew: שחימי - שחורות, ואינן מצננות כל כך כלבנות. ובלשון מורי: שחימי — של נחשת; חיורי — של חרס:
Rashi on Chullin 55b:12:2.english: Dark [vessels] - Black [ones], and they do not cool [the water] as much as white [ones]. And in the words of my teacher: sheḥimei [means vessels] of copper; ḥivorei [means vessels] of earthenware.

Rashi on Chullin 55b:13:1.hebrew: מדקאמר חזר בו - מכלל דמעיקרא הוה פליג:
Rashi on Chullin 55b:13:1.english: From [the fact] that he said, "He retracted" - [It follows] by implication that initially [Rabbi Meir] disagreed.

Rashi on Chullin 55b:14:1.english: The spice merchant - A seller of spices.

Rashi on Chullin 55b:14:2.english: And if [the size of] a sela remained on it - By means of that remainder, it heals.

Rashi on Chullin 55b:16:1.hebrew: דאריך - על פני כל אורך השדרה, וקצר כחוט. ומאי כסלע דקאמר? דאי מצטרפת לאורכו ומשוית ליה עגול, הוה כסלע:
Rashi on Chullin 55b:16:1.english: That it is long - Along the entire length of the spine, and narrow as a thread. And what is [the meaning of] "like a sela" that he said? That if you combine its length and make it round, it would be [the size of] a sela.

Rashi on Chullin 55b:17:1.english: At the place of its navel - We require [a piece of hide the size of] a sela.

Rashi on Chullin 55b:18:1.hebrew: ראשי פרקים - בכל פרקי חוליותיה ועצמות השוק והירך, בעינן שיור כסלע:
Rashi on Chullin 55b:18:1.english: The tips of the joints - At all the joints of its vertebrae and the bones of the shank and the thigh, we require a remainder [the size] of a sela.

Rashi on Chullin 55b:19:1.hebrew: כל העור כולו - כל היכא דמשתייר ההוא כסלע, מעלה ארוכה וחוזר כל עורה לקדמותו:
Rashi on Chullin 55b:19:1.english: The entire hide - Wherever that sela-sized [patch] remains, it heals and its entire hide returns to its former state.

Rashi on Chullin 55b:19:2.hebrew: חוץ מעור בית הפרסות - מן הארכובה ולמטה, דלא הוי עור מפני שהוא רך:
Rashi on Chullin 55b:19:2.english: Except for the hide of the hooves - From the knee downward, which is not [considered] hide because it is soft.

Rashi on Chullin 55b:1:1.hebrew: למקום חריץ - שהגידין מעורין שם, והוא אמצעית הכוליא:
Rashi on Chullin 55b:1:1.english: To the location of the crevice - Where the sinews are attached, and that is the middle of the kidney.

Rashi on Chullin 55b:1:2.english: Authorities on tereifot - Those who issue [halakhic] rulings concerning tereifot.

Rashi on Chullin 55b:1:3.english: In accordance with Rav Avira - In [the case where] the spleen was perforated.

Rashi on Chullin 55b:20:1.hebrew: ואלו שעורותיהן כבשרן - לענין דמטמאין עורן כבשרן, אלמא לאו עור הוא, וקחשיב האי בהדייהו בהעור והרוטב (לקמן חולין דף קכב.):
Rashi on Chullin 55b:20:1.english: And these are those whose hide is like their flesh - With regard to the matter that their hide transmits impurity like their flesh; evidently, it is not [considered] hide, and it reckons this among them in [the chapter entitled] HaOhr VeHaRotev (below, Chullin 122a).

Rashi on Chullin 55b:20:2.english: Do not trouble me - [With an objection] from that Mishnah.

Rashi on Chullin 55b:20:3.hebrew: שבלשון יחיד אני שונה אותה - כלומר, יחידאה היא, ולא קיימינן כוותיה. דר' שמעון קתני לה, ופליגי עליה — דת"ק לא תנא אלא עור שתחת האליה לחודיה:
Rashi on Chullin 55b:20:3.english: As I teach it in the singular - That is to say, it is an individual [opinion], and we do not rule in accordance with him; for Rabbi Shimon taught it, and [the Rabbis] disagree with him, as the first Tanna taught only the hide beneath the fat tail alone.

Rashi on Chullin 55b:21:1.english: An offering that was slaughtered with the intention to eat of it or to burn of it outside its [designated] place of consumption.

Rashi on Chullin 55b:21:2.hebrew: פסול ואין בו כרת - לאוכל הימנו כהלכתו, ואם שחטו על מנת לאכול או להקטיר הימנו:
Rashi on Chullin 55b:21:2.english: Unfit, and there is no excision for it - [This applies] to one who partakes of it according to its halakhah; and [this is] if he slaughtered it with intent to eat or to burn of it [outside its designated place].

Rashi on Chullin 55b:21:3.hebrew: חוץ לזמנו פיגול וחייבין עליו כרת - האוכל ממנו, אפילו כהלכתו. ומקרא נפקא לן בפרק שני דזבחים (דף כח.). ועור שתחת הזנב רך הוא, ונפסל קרבן במחשבת אכילתו כבשר; ובעולה, שכולה כליל, לא פסלה מחשבת אכילה, אלא מחשבת הקטרה:
Rashi on Chullin 55b:21:3.english: Beyond its designated time, it is piggul, and one is liable to excision on its account - [Liability to excision is incurred by] one who eats from it, even [if eaten] in its proper manner. And from Scripture it is derived for us in the second chapter of Zevachim (28a). And the hide beneath the tail is soft, and an offering is invalidated by the intention to eat it, like meat; but in [the case of] a burnt offering, which is entirely consumed, an intention of eating does not invalidate [it], but rather an intention of burning [on the altar].

Rashi on Chullin 55b:22:3.hebrew: עגל הרך - מפרש בהעור והרוטב (לקמן חולין קכב.): כל זמן שיונק:
Rashi on Chullin 55b:22:3.english: A young calf - It is explained in [the chapter entitled] Ha’or Veharotev (below, Chullin 122a): As long as it suckles.

Rashi on Chullin 55b:22:4.english: And all that the Sages listed - In [the chapter entitled] Ha’or Veharotev (ibid.), with regard to hides [treated] like flesh.

Rashi on Chullin 55b:2:1.hebrew: ולא אמרן - דלית הלכתא כוותיה, אלא דאינקב בקולשיה:
Rashi on Chullin 55b:2:1.english: And we did not say - that the halakha is not in accordance with him, except where it was perforated in its thin [part].

Rashi on Chullin 55b:2:2.english: In its thick [part] - In its thickness, above.

Rashi on Chullin 55b:2:3.hebrew: ואי אשתייר - בעובי דופנו, ולא יצא המחט לחוץ, ויש הגנה כנגדו כעובי דינר — כשר:
Rashi on Chullin 55b:2:3.english: And if [there] remained - [Intact tissue remained] in the thickness of its wall, and the needle did not emerge to the outside, and there is a protective [layer] opposite it [as thick] as the thickness of a dinar — [the animal is] kosher.

Rashi on Chullin 55b:3:1.hebrew: וכ"ש כו' - דוקיא הוא דדייקנא ממילתייהו:
Rashi on Chullin 55b:3:1.english: And all the more so, etc. - It is an inference that we deduce from their statement:

Rashi on Chullin 55b:4:1.english: Pus is kosher in the lung - As we said (above, Chullin 48a), where [the lungs] have rock-hard cysts.

Rashi on Chullin 55b:4:2.hebrew: ופסול בכוליא - כדאמרן בריש פירקין (חולין דף מח.): מליא מוגלא — טרפה, מים זכין — כשרה; ואוקימנא בכוליא:
Rashi on Chullin 55b:4:2.english: And unfit in the kidney - As we said at the beginning of our chapter (Chullin 48a): "[If it is] full of pus, [it is] a tereifah; [if] clear fluid, [it is] kosher," and we established it [as referring] to the kidney.

Rashi on Chullin 55b:4:3.english: And behold, clear fluid, which is kosher both here and there - I do not know what the difficulty is.

Rashi on Chullin 55b:4:4.hebrew: אלא - לא תימא כל שכן, דאע"ג דנקב פסול בריאה וכשר בכוליא, איכא מידי דכשר בריאה ופסול בכוליא — דאין אומרים בטרפות כו', דיש אבר שחולי זה קשה לו, ואין חולי זה קשה לו:
Rashi on Chullin 55b:4:4.english: Rather - Do not say “all the more so,” for even though a perforation is unfit in the lung and kosher in the kidney, there is something that is kosher in the lung and unfit in the kidney — for one does not say with regard to tereifot, etc., as there is an organ for which this illness is severe, and this illness is not severe for [another organ].

Rashi on Chullin 55b:4:5.hebrew: שהרי חותכה מכאן ומתה כו' - חתוך סימנין או גיד צוארה — ומתה, חתוך כל כתפיה — וחיה:
Rashi on Chullin 55b:4:5.english: For behold, one cuts it from here and it dies, etc. - Cut the simanim [the trachea and esophagus] or the tendon of its neck — and it dies; cut its entire shoulder — and it lives.

Rashi on Chullin 55b:6:1.english: Shrank - The kidney shrank on its own due to illness.

Rashi on Chullin 55b:8:2.english: It is the tarpaḥat - As [stated] below (Chullin 56b): "They ruled regarding a tarpaḥat like Rabbi [ruled] regarding the crop."

Rashi on Chullin 55b:8:3.english: It is the shalpuḥit - That which was stated earlier in our chapter (Chullin 48a).

Rashi on Chullin 55b:9:1.hebrew: צמקה - יבשה. ו"שדים צומקים" מתרגמינן: "דדין יבשין" (הושע ט):
Rashi on Chullin 55b:9:1.english: Shriveled - Dried up. And “shriveled breasts” we translate [in the Targum as] “dried breasts” (Hosea 9).

Rashi on Chullin 55b:9:2.english: By the hand of Heaven - [Frightened] by the sound of hail and thunder.

Rashi on Chullin 55b:9:3.hebrew: בידי אדם - שהבעיתה אדם, לא הדרא בריא:
Rashi on Chullin 55b:9:3.english: By the hands of a person - Where a person frightened it, it does not return to [its] healthy state:

Rashi on Chullin 55b:9:4.english: All creatures - [Such as] the roar of a lion and the cry of a fierce lion.

Tosafot on Chullin 55b:20:1.hebrew: בלשון יחיד אני שונה אותה - שבמשנה עצמה היה שונה: "דברי רבי שמעון". אבל אין לפרש משום דאתיא כיחידאה, דמה בכך? האמר בפ' החולץ (יבמות דף מב:): סתם במתניתין ומחלוקת בברייתא — הלכה כסתם:
Tosafot on Chullin 55b:20:1.english: "I teach it in the singular" - That in the Mishnah itself he recited: "The words of Rabbi Shimon." But one should not explain [that he meant] because it follows [the opinion of] an individual [Sage], for what of it? Didn't he say in the chapter [entitled] Hacholetz (Yevamot 42b): [If there is an] anonymous [statement] in the Mishnah and a dispute in a Baraita, the halakha follows the anonymous [statement].

Tosafot on Chullin 55b:4:1.hebrew: והרי מים זכים דכשרים הכא והכא - פ"ה: "לא ידענא מאי קושיא". וי"ל דהכי פירושא: והרי מים זכים דאתו מחמת לקותא, וכשרים בכוליא, ולא גמרינן ממוגלא; ואם כן, אין לדמות הטרפות זו לזו:
Tosafot on Chullin 55b:4:1.english: "And behold, clear fluid, which is kosher both here and there" - Rashi explained: "I do not know what the difficulty is." And one can say that this is the explanation: Behold, clear fluid comes on account of an affliction, yet it is kosher in the kidney, and we do not derive [its status] from pus; and if so, one cannot compare the tereifot to one another.
